Watch Emraan Hashmi on a date with Neha Sharma in this video from the film Crook - sung by Nikhil D'Souza, the music is composed by Pritam for which he was nominated for the Apsara (now Star Guild) award for Best Music in 2011
Song Name - Mere Bina
Movie - Crook
Singer - Nikhil Dsouza
Music - Pritam Chakraborty
Lyrics - Kumaar
Director - Mohit Suri
Studio - Vishesh Films
